_comment: Copy this file outside the repository, fill it in and pass it with --release-info.
Only 'uploader' is mandatory. 'whats_new_md' defaults to the CHANGELOG
section of the packaged version. Do not claim tests that were not done.
summary: This release replaces 0.9.9-rc.5. The archive is distributed as raptor.lha so future Aminet updates can replace the same archive name.
whats_new_md:
### Changed

- Describe the user-visible changes of this release.
- Keep the text factual; it is rendered into both the Aminet readme and the GitHub release notes.
upgrade_notes_md: Describe required manual steps when upgrading from the previous release. Leave empty when there are none.
testing_status_md: State exactly what was tested, on which hardware, and by whom. Do not claim tests that were not performed.
